Diplomats should learn from 1971
2013-04-19T00:44:54+06:00 | Diplomatic Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/diplomats-should-learn-from-1971

Foreign Minister Dipu Moni yesterday urged young diplomats of the country to take lessons from their predecessors who fought on the diplomatic front for the nation's independence in 1971.

“The spirit of 1971 makes comebacks repeatedly and we should be imbibed with it to overcome all adverse situations,” she told a discussion at the foreign ministry marking the establishment of the first independent mission of Bangladesh in Kolkata on this day in 1971.

Mohammad Hossain Ali, the then deputy high commissioner, with 65 Bangladeshi officials and employees pledged allegiance to the Mujibnagar government and hoisted the Bangladesh flag at the deputy high commission replacing the Pakistan flag on April 18, 1971.

Dipu Moni said the Bangladeshi diplomats stationed in different foreign mission, including Washington, London and Paris, worked hard also in the post-war period to secure recognition from international communities of an independent Bangladesh.
